text: CLAUSE 13 OF RULE ONE, THE JOURNAL OF THE LAST DAY'S PROCEEDINGS IS APPROVED. THE CHAIR WILL LEAD THE HOUSE IN THE PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE. I PLEDGE ALLEGIANCE TO THE FLAG OF THE UNITED STATES OF AMERICA AND TO THE REPUBLIC FOR WHICH IT STANDS. ONE NATION UNDER GOD, INDIVISIBLE, WITH LIBERTY AND JUSTICE FOR ALL. YOU MAY BE SEATED. EXCUSE ME. THE CHAIR
